usageNotes: Use this endpoint to toggle a specific APT repository entry on or off within an existing sources file on a PDM node. The `index` is 0-based and refers to the repository's position within the file at `path`; retrieve these values first via the corresponding GET endpoint. Pass the `digest` returned by the GET call to guard against concurrent modifications — the request will be rejected if the file has changed since you read it.

examples.summary: Disable the second repository entry in /etc/apt/sources.list

tips: Call GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories first to get the current list of repositories, their indices, paths, and the file digest.
The digest is strongly recommended in production — omitting it risks clobbering a concurrent change made by another admin or automation.
This endpoint modifies only the enabled/disabled state of an existing repository entry; it cannot add or remove repository lines.
Returns null on success (HTTP 200 with no body); treat any non-2xx response as a failure requiring investigation.
